list.title: Boards
list.intro: Each board is a workflow with its own columns and rules. A task joins a board when it is created and stays on it.

empty.title: No boards yet
empty.body: A board holds the columns tasks move through. Create one to start adding tasks.

menu.default_undeletable: New tasks land on the default board. Make another board the default to delete this one.

detail.name: Name
detail.name_required: A board needs a name. The old one stays.
detail.description_placeholder: Reported bugs, from triage to release
detail.description_hint: Shown under the board's name. Up to 280 characters.

columns.title: Columns
columns.intro: Drag a column by its handle to reorder it, or use its menu to rename it, pick a color, set what happens in it or delete it. Changes save as you make them and also show on the board.

chips.none: Tasks wait here for a person.

types.title: Task types
types.intro: A task type walks the same columns but can skip some: a bugfix can go from Backlog straight to In progress while a feature still passes Refinement. Every type starts and finishes in the same columns.
types.locked_initial: {stage} is where tasks start, so every type passes through it.
types.locked_terminal: {stage} is where work finishes, so every type passes through it.
types.remove_message: Tasks of this type keep their place. If any carry it, you choose what they become before the change saves.

none.one: No task types on this board. Every task walks its {count} column.
none.other: No task types on this board. Every task walks all {count} columns.

types.name_required: Type a name for the task type.
types.slug_empty: The id comes from the name.

fix_skipped.one: {count} task sits in {stage}, which this change makes its type skip.
fix_skipped.other: {count} tasks sit in {stage}, which this change makes their type skip.

new.title: New board
new.name: Name
new.name_required: Type a name for the board.
new.slug_empty: The id comes from the name and can't change later.
new.from_hint: Pick a board to copy its columns with their behavior and approvals. Editing the copy never touches the original.
new.id_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, up to 32. Tasks and metrics carry it, so it can't change later.
new.id_invalid: {id} can't be an id. Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, up to 32.

delete.title: Delete board {board}?
delete.move_note: Each task lands in the column with the same id on that board, or in its first column.
delete.lost: The board's columns, behavior and task types are deleted with it. This can't be undone.

errors.network: The daemon didn't answer. Check your connection and try again.
errors.missing: There is no board with the id {board}. It may have been deleted.
